system.longDesc:
Cost: 1–3 SP

NOTE: You may only choose stunts from this list when you earn the SP while making an attack with a gun. Some gun stunts require a specific type of gun, such as a pistol, rifle, or automatic weapon.

Immediately move up to (SP spent) meters in any direction, and apply this attack to anyone within (SP spent) meters of your original target; you can’t selectively exclude anyone in the area. Halve the damage dealt to the additional targets (round up).
